compute_t2v_metrics: compute text-to-video retrieval metrics from a similarity matrix with optional query masks
compute_v2t_metrics: compute video-to-text retrieval metrics from a similarity matrix by finding closest ground truth caption ranks
compute_egomcq_accuracy: compute EgoMCQ accuracy metrics grouped by inter-video and intra-video question types
compute_charades_metrics: compute Charades action recognition mAP metrics from submission and ground truth arrays
compute_pnr_metrics: compute point-of-no-return keyframe distance metrics from predictions and frame timestamps
